title: Market range: The Fed's rate is 4.25% or lower after April: the rises stop after December, or reverse
html:
Market range

15.0%–16.0%

The Fed's rate is 4.25% or lower after April: the rises stop after December, or reverse

Lower bound15.0%
Forecast15.5%
Upper bound16.0%
0%100%

What sets the lower bound

  1. YES bid on “Will the upper bound of the federal funds rate be above 4.25% following the Fed's Apr 28, 2027 meeting?”, for “The Fed's rate is 4.50% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting”: 84.0%
  2. “The Fed's rate is 4.75% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting” implies “The Fed's rate is 4.50% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting”
  3. “The Fed's rate is 4.50% after April: two more rises” is one way “The Fed's rate is 4.75% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting” can turn out
  4. “The Fed's rate is 4.25% or lower after April: the rises stop after December, or reverse” is one way “The Fed's rate is 4.75% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting” can turn out

What sets the upper bound

  1. YES ask on “Will the upper bound of the federal funds rate be above 4.25% following the Fed's Apr 28, 2027 meeting?”, for “The Fed's rate is 4.50% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting”: 85.0%
  2. “The Fed's rate is 4.75% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting” implies “The Fed's rate is 4.50% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting”
  3. “The Fed's rate is 4.50% after April: two more rises” is one way “The Fed's rate is 4.75% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting” can turn out
  4. “The Fed's rate is 4.25% or lower after April: the rises stop after December, or reverse” is one way “The Fed's rate is 4.75% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting” can turn out
